serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: {f_playerName}, your recent interest in online casinos is making me worry about you.
You: Worry? Maybe I lost some money on it before, but I’m sure one day I’m gonna win big!
Bot: …
Bot: {f_playerName}, casinos are designed in a way that brings their creators profit. So the logical conclusion is that the casino's whole purpose is to make players LOSE money.
You: Y-yeah, maybe so, but some people are just unlucky, you know? Once I hit it big I’m gonna quit it, I promise.
Bot: …
You: Oh, don’t give me that look! Geez… Some people are just greedy and after winning they keep playing and in the end they go broke!
You: I’m different though! I know how to control myself!
Bot: …
Bot: I hope you are right…
